name: Token vesting
claim: Pay tokens out gradually, not all at once
summary: Lock CEP-18 tokens for a teammate, an investor or a contributor. They unlock a little at a time after a cliff, and the recipient claims what has unlocked.

name: Multisend
claim: Pay many accounts with one signature
summary: Paste a list of recipients and amounts and send CSPR or a CEP-18 token to all of them in one transaction: everyone is paid, or nobody is.

name: Payment streaming
claim: Pay someone by the second, not once a month
summary: A sender deposits CEP-18 tokens once and they reach the recipient continuously, second by second, until the end date. The recipient withdraws what has arrived whenever they like, and the sender can stop the stream to take back what has not.

name: Liquidity locker
claim: Show everyone that your liquidity cannot be pulled
summary: Lock CEP-18 tokens, such as DEX pool tokens, in a contract with no admin until a date that can only move later. Anyone can paste a token address and see, without a wallet, how much is locked, by whom and until when.

name: Timelock
claim: Every change is announced before it happens
summary: A timelock holds the admin keys of other contracts and runs each change only after a public delay, so users see what is coming and have time to leave. Propose a new fee for a contract the timelock owns, watch it wait, then execute it.

name: Escrow
claim: Pay a stranger only once the deal is done
summary: A buyer's CEP-18 tokens wait in a contract until the buyer releases them to the seller or the seller sends them back. If they disagree, either opens a dispute and an arbiter they both chose decides who gets the tokens, or splits them.

name: Payment splitter
claim: Share every payment by fixed parts
summary: List payees and their shares once; anyone can then pay CEP-18 tokens into the split, and each payee withdraws their part when they like. The page shows how a payment will be divided before you send it.

name: Crowdfunding
claim: Raise tokens for an idea, all or nothing
summary: Anyone starts a campaign with a CEP-18 token, a goal and a deadline, and backers pledge tokens to it until the deadline. If the pledges reach the goal, the creator claims all of them; if not, every backer takes their pledge back.

name: Airdrop
claim: Give tokens to a long list of people, and let each of them claim their own
summary: Put the tokens for a whole list into the contract in one transaction; only a 32-byte fingerprint of the list goes on chain. Each recipient opens the shared list, the page works out their proof, and they claim their amount, paying their own fee.

name: Governor
claim: Token holders decide, a timelock carries it out
summary: Holders of a test token vote on a new fee by depositing their tokens for or against it, and take them back when the vote ends. A fee that passes is handed to the timelock demo's timelock, which sets it after its public one-minute delay.
